fortune.tiedMessage: May your wish find its way…

daikichi: The brightest of fortunes — a perfect time to begin something new.
Your wishes will find their way. Step forward without hesitation.
The one you've been waiting for is near. Welcome the encounter.
Your financial fortune is rising. An unexpected windfall may appear.
Strong health flows through you. Move freely and with energy.
chukichi: Your fortune rides a gentle rise.
A season when quiet effort bears fruit.
Travel is favored. Perhaps a short journey awaits.
Signs of prosperity in your work.
shokichi: A small happiness is drawing near.
Good fortune in conversations with friends.
Something lost may yet return to you.
Mind your health and all will flow smoothly.
kichi: A day of quiet calm awaits you.
Keeping to the familiar brings good fortune.
When uncertain, turn to those around you.
A gentle walk or stretch will lift your luck.
Do not forget to give thanks.
suekichi: A time to endure — your fortune will open in time.
Haste brings missteps. Act with care.
Reaching out to an old friend may bring a quiet blessing.
A tidy room invites a shift in spirit.
Small kindnesses draw good fortune to you.
kyo: Do not push forward. Watch and wait.
Take care not to leave things behind.
Unexpected expenses may arise. Hold your purse close.
Fatigue builds quickly. Rest before it settles in.
daikyo: The calm before the storm — tread with care.
Health comes first. Rethink a demanding schedule.
Honor the trust of others. Avoid misunderstandings.
It is darkest before dawn — morning will surely come.

daikichi.wish: It will come true just as you hope.
daikichi.waitingPerson: Good tidings — they will arrive soon.
daikichi.lostItem: It will return. Look in a high place.
daikichi.business: Profit is likely. Proceed with confidence.
daikichi.study: Study with a calm and settled mind.
daikichi.health: In fine form. Your body will carry you far.
daikichi.love: A meaningful encounter awaits. Be open.

chukichi.wish: It will come true — but do not let your guard down.
chukichi.waitingPerson: They will come. Anticipate with joy.
chukichi.lostItem: Not easily found, yet it will appear.
chukichi.business: Profitable, but watch what you spend.
chukichi.love: A good encounter may arrive. Be yourself.

shokichi.wish: A modest wish may come true.
shokichi.waitingPerson: They will come. Await word from them.
shokichi.lostItem: It rests somewhere within your home.
shokichi.study: A time to strengthen the foundations.
shokichi.love: Romance may grow from a friendship.

kichi.wish: It will come true, but in its own time.
kichi.business: Hold steady on your current course.
kichi.health: Well enough, if you do not overdo it.

suekichi.business: Better not to chase profit for now.
suekichi.study: A season of patience — it will blossom later.
suekichi.love: A time to grow within yourself.

kyo.wish: It will not come true just yet.
kyo.study: A slump. Change your setting, change your mood.
kyo.health: Watch for signs of illness — act early.
kyo.love: Better to watch quietly for now.

daikyo.wish: It may be wisest to let it go.
daikyo.waitingPerson: They will not come. Do not expect them.
daikyo.business: Expect losses. A season to endure.
daikyo.study: Begin again, as if from the start.
daikyo.health: Health above all. Do not push yourself.
daikyo.love: Place yourself before romance for now.
